rules.statement: A Parliamentary Secretary holds a public office under the Crown and is not in the service of His Majesty, but rather holds office during His Majesty's pleasure.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Order in Council, as I have stated earlier, expressly provides that 'every Parliamentary Secretary shall hold office during His-Majesty's pleasure' (section 49) and makes provision whereby a Parliamentary Secretary 'may at any time resign his office'. A Parliamentary Secretary has 'Parliamentary and departmental duties to perform' (section 47), and whenever he is unable to perform 'any of the functions of his office' power is taken for the appointment of a substitute. He is also required to take an oath of office (section 49 (4)) like any other holder of an office."
